name: 菲胡
meaning: 豐盛的流動，以及懂得讓資源循環的智慧。
element: 火（生命的熱度與創造的能量）

upright.text: 豐盛正朝你而來--可能是新的收入、新的機會，或是一段被滋養的關係。菲胡是古人計算財富的牛群，提醒你：真正的富足不在於囤積，而在於流動。當你願意大方分享、也安心接受，能量就會持續循環回到你身上。現在很適合好好把握眼前的資源，讓它活起來。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺資源有點卡住，或是付出與收穫一時對不上。這不是壞事，而是邀請你停下來看看：是不是抓得太緊，反而讓流動停了？也許現在更適合先守成、整理手邊的東西，等時機重新對上。先照顧好自己當下擁有的，富足感有機會慢慢回到生活裡。

en.name: Fehu
en.title: Cattle of Wealth
en.meaning: The flow of abundance, and the wisdom to keep resources moving.
en.element: Fire (the heat of life and creative energy)

upright.text: Abundance is heading your way -- maybe new income, a new opportunity, or a relationship that nourishes you. Fehu, the cattle the ancients counted their wealth by, reminds you that real abundance isn't about hoarding, it's about keeping things moving. When you give generously and receive without guilt, the energy keeps cycling back to you. Now is a good time to make the most of what's in front of you and put it to use.

reversed.text: You might feel like resources are stuck, or that what you're putting in and what you're getting back don't match up. That's not a bad thing -- it's an invitation to pause and ask whether you're holding on too tight, which is what stopped the flow. This may be a better time to conserve and get your own things in order while you wait for the timing to line up again. Take care of what you already have, and a sense of abundance will slowly find its way back.

name: 烏魯茲
meaning: 未經馴化的原始生命力與自我重建的勇氣。
element: 土（大地的根基與身體的能量）

upright.text: 一股原始的生命力正在你體內甦醒，像曠野上的野牛，充滿衝勁與韌性。烏魯茲告訴你：你比自己想像的更有力量。這是適合主動出擊、突破舊框架的時刻。相信自己的本能與身體的直覺，勇敢往前，你有能力開創屬於自己的新局。

reversed.text: 你也許感覺力氣使不上、有點疲憊或心有餘而力不足。這是身體與心在提醒你：該慢下來、好好休養了。力量不是一直猛衝，懂得停下來蓄力也是一種勇敢。給自己一點空間恢復，慢慢找回屬於你的節奏。

en.name: Uruz
en.title: Wild Ox
en.meaning: Untamed vital force, and the courage to rebuild yourself.
en.element: Earth (the ground beneath you and the body's energy)

upright.text: A raw life force is waking up inside you, like a wild ox on the open plain, full of drive and resilience. Uruz tells you that you're stronger than you think. This is a good time to take the initiative and break out of an old frame. Trust your instincts and your body's gut sense, and move forward boldly -- you're capable of building something new that's genuinely yours.

reversed.text: You might feel drained, a little worn out, or like your will outpaces your energy. Your body and mind are telling you it's time to slow down and recover. Strength isn't only about charging forward -- knowing when to stop and recharge is its own kind of courage. Give yourself room to recover, and you'll gradually find your rhythm again.

name: 瑟里薩茲
meaning: 保護自己的防衛力量，以及面對衝突的決斷。
element: 火（雷神索爾的力量與守護）

upright.text: 這個符文像雷神之鎚，帶著保護與突破的力量。眼前或許有挑戰、有需要捍衛的事，但你並不孤單--你擁有設立界線、守護自己的能力。瑟里薩茲提醒你：在行動前先沉住氣想清楚，把力量用在對的地方。該堅定時就堅定，你有資格保護自己重視的人事物。

reversed.text: 你可能正處在緊繃或對立的氣氛裡，或是防備心過重，把自己也困住了。這是個邀請：先深呼吸，別急著反擊。有些衝突其實可以用更柔軟的方式化解。給自己時間冷靜思考，分清楚什麼值得堅持、什麼可以放下，會讓你輕鬆許多。

en.name: Thurisaz
en.title: Giant's Thorn
en.meaning: The protective force of setting boundaries, and decisiveness in facing conflict.
en.element: Fire (Thor's power and protection)

upright.text: This rune carries the force of Thor's hammer -- protection and breakthrough in one. There may be a challenge ahead, something worth defending, but you're not alone in it: you have the ability to set boundaries and protect yourself. Thurisaz reminds you to steady yourself and think clearly before acting, and to aim that strength where it belongs. Stand firm when it counts -- you have every right to protect what matters to you.

reversed.text: You might be caught in a tense or adversarial mood, or so defensive that you've boxed yourself in. Take a breath before you strike back. Some conflicts can actually be resolved more gently than you think. Give yourself time to think clearly, sort out what's worth holding your ground on and what you can let go of -- it'll lighten the load.

name: 安蘇茲
meaning: 智慧的訊息、靈感的啟發與真誠的溝通。
element: 風（語言、思想與流動的訊息）

upright.text: 一個重要的訊息或靈感即將來到你身邊--可能是一句點醒你的話、一場關鍵的對話，或是內心忽然浮現的清明。安蘇茲與智慧之神奧丁相連，邀請你保持耳朵與心都打開，留意身邊的徵兆。現在也很適合真誠地表達自己，把想說的話好好說出口。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺溝通有點不順，或收到的訊息讓人困惑、容易產生誤會。這是提醒你：先別急著相信或下定論，多聽、多確認，分辨什麼才是真正重要的聲音。當外界太吵雜時，回到內心安靜片刻，你會更清楚自己真正想表達與想聽見的是什麼。

en.name: Ansuz
en.title: Breath of the Gods
en.meaning: A message of wisdom, a spark of inspiration, and honest communication.
en.element: Air (language, thought, and the flow of messages)

upright.text: An important message or spark of inspiration is on its way to you -- maybe a sentence that wakes you up, a key conversation, or a moment of sudden clarity. Ansuz is linked to Odin, god of wisdom, and invites you to keep your ears and heart open to the signs around you. This is also a good time to speak honestly and say what you actually mean.

reversed.text: Communication may feel a little off, or a message you received might be confusing and easy to misread. Don't rush to believe or conclude anything -- listen more, confirm more, and figure out what voice actually matters. When the outside world gets too noisy, come back to a quiet moment within, and you'll get clearer on what you really want to say and hear.

name: 萊多
meaning: 人生的旅程、行動的方向與屬於自己的節奏。
element: 風（移動、旅行與前進的方向）

upright.text: 你正踏上一段屬於自己的旅程--也許是真實的出發，也許是人生的新階段。萊多像滾動的車輪，提醒你：路要一步步走，重點不是衝多快，而是找到自己舒服的節奏。相信你正走在對的方向上，過程中的每個轉彎都有它的意義。順著心走，路會慢慢清晰。

reversed.text: 你可能覺得旅程卡關，或懷疑自己是不是走偏了。別著急，這正是停下來看地圖的好時機。有時候繞點路、甚至原地休息，都是旅程的一部分。重新問問自己真正想去的地方，調整步伐再出發。方向會在你願意誠實面對自己時重新浮現。

en.name: Raidho
en.title: Wheel of the Journey
en.meaning: Life's journey, the direction of action, and finding your own pace.
en.element: Air (movement, travel, and forward direction)

upright.text: You're setting out on a journey that's entirely your own -- maybe a literal trip, or a new chapter of life. Raidho, the turning wheel, reminds you the road is walked step by step; what matters isn't speed but finding the pace that's right for you. Trust that you're on the right path, and that every turn along the way has meaning. Follow your heart, and the road will gradually come into focus.

reversed.text: You might feel stuck on this journey, or wonder if you've gone off track. Don't panic -- this is a good moment to stop and check the map. Sometimes a detour, or even standing still, is part of the trip. Ask yourself honestly where you actually want to go, adjust your pace, and set off again -- direction tends to reappear once you're willing to be honest with yourself.

name: 開納茲
meaning: 照亮黑暗的洞見、創造的熱情與內在的明燈。
element: 火（光明、啟發與創造之火）

upright.text: 一盞明燈在你心中點亮。開納茲是黑暗裡的火炬，象徵突如其來的洞見、創作的靈感，以及重新燃起的熱情。原本看不清的事，現在開始有了輪廓。這是適合學習、創造、把點子付諸行動的時刻。順著這股熱情走，讓你內在的光照亮接下來的路。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺靈感枯竭、熱情暫時退潮，或是某件事一時看不清方向。這很正常--火也需要添柴才能再旺起來。別逼自己硬擠，先讓心休息、補充養分，靈感往往會在放鬆時悄悄回來。看不清的時候，就先安靜等待那盞燈重新亮起。

en.name: Kenaz
en.title: Torch's Flame
en.meaning: Insight that lights up the dark, creative passion, and an inner lamp.
en.element: Fire (light, inspiration, and the fire of creation)

upright.text: A light has come on inside you. Kenaz is the torch in the dark, symbolizing sudden insight, creative inspiration, and a passion reignited. Something that was unclear is starting to take shape. This is a good time for learning, creating, and turning an idea into action. Follow that passion, and let your inner light show you the next stretch of the road.

reversed.text: Inspiration may feel dried up, your passion may have cooled off, or something may be temporarily unclear. That's normal -- even fire needs more fuel to burn bright again. Don't force it; let your mind rest and refill, and inspiration tends to sneak back in when you relax. When you can't see clearly, wait quietly for the light to come back on.

name: 基波
meaning: 雙向的給予、平等的連結與真誠的關係。
element: 風（人與人之間流動的情誼）

upright.text: 基波是一份禮物，也是一份心意的交換。它象徵兩個人之間真誠、平等的連結--可能是一段加深的關係、一次美好的合作，或一份意外的善意。這個符文提醒你：最美的關係是來回流動的，你給出去的，也會以某種方式回到你身上。敞開心，去給予，也安心地接受。

reversed.text: 基波正逆位同形，它也邀請你看見關係的另一個角度：你是不是付出得多、收得少，或一直委屈自己成全別人？真正健康的給予是雙向的。在繼續對別人好的同時，記得也留一份溫柔給自己，讓這份連結回到平衡。

en.name: Gebo
en.title: Gift Exchange
en.meaning: Mutual giving, an equal bond, and genuine relationship.
en.element: Air (the current of goodwill between people)

upright.text: Gebo is a gift, and an exchange of goodwill. It symbolizes an honest, equal bond between two people -- maybe a deepening relationship, a great collaboration, or an unexpected kindness. This rune reminds you that the best relationships flow both ways: what you give tends to come back to you in some form. Open your heart, give freely, and receive with ease.

reversed.text: Gebo looks the same upright or reversed, but it also invites you to notice the other side of a relationship: are you giving more than you're getting, or making yourself smaller to please someone else? True giving flows in both directions. As you keep being good to others, remember to save some kindness for yourself too, so the connection returns to balance.

name: 溫究
meaning: 純粹的快樂、內在的和諧與內在願望被看見的滿足。
element: 風（喜悅與和諧的氣息）

upright.text: 一陣溫暖的喜悅正吹進你的生活。溫究象徵發自內心的快樂、人際的和諧，以及一切歸位的滿足感。這是值得好好慶祝與感恩的時刻--你的努力正開花結果，身邊的關係也變得更融洽。允許自己單純地開心，享受當下的美好，幸福不需要理由。

reversed.text: 你也許表面看起來還好，心裡卻有點空，或快樂得不太踏實。這是溫柔的提醒：別勉強自己一直微笑。允許低落的情緒存在，誠實面對心裡真正的感受，反而是找回喜悅的第一步。先把自己照顧好，真實的快樂會慢慢回到你身邊。

en.name: Wunjo
en.title: Wind of Joy
en.meaning: Pure happiness, inner harmony, and the satisfaction of being truly seen.
en.element: Air (the breath of joy and harmony)

upright.text: A warm gust of joy is blowing into your life. Wunjo represents heartfelt happiness, harmony with others, and the satisfaction of things falling into place. This is a moment worth celebrating and feeling grateful for -- your effort is bearing fruit, and your relationships are growing smoother too. Let yourself simply be happy; joy doesn't need a reason.

reversed.text: You might look fine on the outside while feeling a bit hollow, or your happiness may feel a little forced. Don't push yourself to keep smiling. Letting a low mood exist, and being honest about what you actually feel, is the first step back to real joy. Take care of yourself first, and genuine happiness will slowly find its way back.

name: 哈格拉茲
meaning: 突如其來的轉變，以及破壞之後孕育的新生。
element: 冰（風暴、洗滌與轉化的力量）

upright.text: 哈格拉茲像一場突如其來的冰雹，看似來勢洶洶，卻也把舊有的、不再適合的事物一併洗刷乾淨。它提醒你：有些改變雖然措手不及，卻是讓你重新整理人生的契機。風暴也會有逐漸平息的時候，而被沖刷後的土地往往更肥沃。接受變化，也許這段重整，能為新的可能留下空間。

reversed.text: 哈格拉茲正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：你是不是還在抗拒某個已經發生的改變，遲遲不願放手？越用力對抗，越會感到疲憊。試著鬆開緊握的雙手，允許事情以它的方式流動。當你願意接納，你可能會慢慢重新感覺到站穩的力量。

en.name: Hagalaz
en.title: Strike of Hail
en.meaning: A sudden shift, and the new growth that follows destruction.
en.element: Ice (storm, cleansing, and transformative force)

upright.text: Hagalaz is like a sudden hailstorm -- fierce on arrival, but it also washes away what's old and no longer fits. It reminds you that some changes, however abrupt, are a chance to reorganize your life. Every storm eventually passes, and the ground it leaves behind is often richer. Accept the change -- this reset may clear space for something new.

reversed.text: Hagalaz looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: are you still resisting a change that's already happened, unwilling to let go? The harder you fight it, the more exhausted you get. Try loosening your grip and letting things move in their own way. Once you're willing to accept it, you may slowly feel steady ground return under your feet.

name: 瑙提茲
meaning: 在限制中淬鍊的耐心，以及看清真正需要的智慧。
element: 火（在匱乏中磨出的內在火光）

upright.text: 眼前的限制或等待，其實藏著一份重要的功課。瑙提茲是古人在寒夜裡鑽木取火的需要--正是在這份不容易裡，磨出了你的耐心與韌性。這個符文邀請你誠實面對：什麼才是你真正需要的？放下那些其實不必要的，你會發現困境也能成為成長的養分。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺被某個處境困住，忍不住想怪罪環境或他人。這是個溫柔的提醒：把目光從「都是別人的錯」轉回「我可以做些什麼」。當你願意為自己的處境負起一點責任，看似綁住你的繩結，往往就會開始鬆動。你比想像中更有選擇權。

en.name: Nauthiz
en.title: Fire of Need
en.meaning: Patience forged under constraint, and the wisdom to see what you truly need.
en.element: Fire (an inner spark struck in scarcity)

upright.text: The limitation or waiting in front of you is hiding an important lesson. Nauthiz is the friction our ancestors used to strike fire on a cold night -- it's exactly this hardship that forges your patience and resilience. This rune invites you to be honest: what do you actually need? Let go of what's unnecessary, and you may find the hard patch turns into real growth.

reversed.text: You might feel stuck in a situation and want to blame the circumstances or other people. Gently turn your attention from 'it's someone else's fault' to 'what can I actually do.' Once you're willing to take some responsibility for your situation, the knot that seemed to be binding you often starts to loosen. You have more choice than you think.

name: 伊薩
meaning: 暫停與沉澱，以及在靜止中累積的力量。
element: 冰（凝結、沉靜與內在的清明）

upright.text: 事情彷彿停了下來，像結了一層薄冰--但這不是壞事。伊薩邀請你慢下來、靜下心，把這段看似停滯的時光，當成沉澱與蓄力的禮物。有些事急不得，需要時間慢慢凝結成形。趁這段安靜，好好整理思緒、傾聽內心，等冰融的那刻，你會更清楚該往哪走。

reversed.text: 伊薩正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：靜止久了，是不是不小心把心也封了起來，對人對事都提不起勁？適度的暫停是休息，過度的封閉卻會讓人孤單。試著為生活添一點暖意，主動跟人連結、做一件小小喜歡的事，讓凍住的能量重新流動起來。

en.name: Isa
en.title: Ice of Stillness
en.meaning: A pause and a settling, and the strength that gathers in stillness.
en.element: Ice (stillness, quiet, and inner clarity)

upright.text: Things seem to have come to a stop, like a thin layer of ice -- but that's not a bad thing. Isa invites you to slow down and be still, treating this apparently stagnant time as a gift of settling and gathering strength. Some things can't be rushed; they need time to take shape. Use this quiet stretch to sort your thoughts and listen inward -- when the ice melts, you'll know more clearly which way to go.

reversed.text: Isa looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: has stillness gone on so long that your heart has frozen a little too, leaving you unmotivated about people and things? A healthy pause is rest, but too much closing-off leaves you isolated. Add a little warmth to your life -- reach out, do one small thing you enjoy, and let the frozen energy start moving again.

name: 耶拉
meaning: 耕耘後的收成，以及順應自然循環的耐心。
element: 土（季節更迭與耕耘的果實）

upright.text: 耶拉是一整年的循環，象徵你過去的耕耘終於要迎來收成。它提醒你：好事正在路上，但豐收有它自己的時節，急不來。就像農夫順應四季，你也可以持續地做對的事、耐心等待，讓過程慢慢成形。相信過程，你播下的種子值得被耐心看待。

reversed.text: 耶拉正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：你是不是在快收成前感到灰心，或覺得成果不如預期，動了放棄的念頭？有時候只是時節還沒到。回頭看看自己一路的耕耘，給它多一點時間。也檢視一下期待是否切合實際，調整步伐後，收穫往往就在不遠處。

en.name: Jera
en.title: Year of Harvest
en.meaning: The harvest after labor, and the patience to move with natural cycles.
en.element: Earth (the turning seasons and the fruit of labor)

upright.text: Jera is a full year's cycle, symbolizing that your past effort is finally coming to fruition. It reminds you: good things are on the way, but harvest has its own season and can't be rushed. Like a farmer following the seasons, you can keep doing the right things and wait patiently while the process takes shape. Trust it -- the seeds you planted deserve patience.

reversed.text: Jera looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: are you losing heart right before the harvest, feeling the results fall short, and thinking about giving up? Sometimes it just isn't the season yet. Look back at everything you've put in, and give it a little more time. Check whether your expectations are realistic too -- adjust your pace, and the harvest is often closer than it seems.

name: 埃瓦茲
meaning: 紫杉所象徵的深層內在轉化，以及連結生命不同階段的軸心（與『馬之程』艾瓦茲不同）。
element: 土（紫杉之樹的根與連結上下界的軸心）

upright.text: 埃瓦茲常與紫杉、生命階段的轉化，以及上下界的連結感相關，象徵一場深刻的內在蛻變正在發生。也許某個階段正在結束，另一個自己正在誕生。這樣的轉化常伴隨不安，但它是讓你變得更完整的必經之路。信任這個過程，就像樹木落葉後再抽新芽--你正在更深地扎根，準備迎接更遼闊的成長。

reversed.text: 埃瓦茲正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：你是不是正抗拒某個該放下的階段，緊抓著熟悉的舊模式不肯改變？蛻變雖然讓人害怕，但停在原地反而更累。試著鬆開對「過去的自己」的執著，溫柔地允許改變發生。當你願意轉身，新的可能就會在前方展開。

en.name: Eihwaz
en.title: Yew Tree
en.meaning: The deep inner transformation the yew represents, and the axis connecting different stages of life.
en.element: Earth (the yew's roots, an axis linking upper and lower worlds)

upright.text: Eihwaz is tied to the yew tree, to transitions between life stages, and to a sense of connection between worlds -- it signals a deep inner transformation underway. Some chapter may be ending while another version of you is being born. This kind of change often comes with unease, but it's a necessary road toward becoming more whole. Trust the process, like a tree shedding leaves before new growth -- you're putting down deeper roots to prepare for wider growth ahead.

keywords: let go of the old self
reversed.text: Eihwaz looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: are you resisting a stage you should be leaving, clinging to a familiar old pattern? Transformation is frightening, but staying put is often more exhausting. Try loosening your grip on 'who you used to be,' and gently allow the change to happen. Once you're willing to turn the corner, new possibilities open up ahead.

name: 佩斯洛
meaning: 隱藏的機緣、命運的奧秘與尚未揭曉的可能。
element: 水（命運、機運與深藏的秘密）

upright.text: 佩斯洛像一只盛裝命運的杯子，提醒你：生命中有些美好的機緣，正悄悄醞釀著。也許是一個意外的轉機，或一段藏在表面下、即將浮現的真相。這是個適合保持好奇與開放的時刻，別把一切都計畫得太死。對未知多一點信任，未知之中也可能藏著值得留意的轉折。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺運氣有點不順，或某件原本期待的事遲遲沒有著落。別氣餒，有些緣分需要時間醞釀，強求反而適得其反。試著放下對結果的執著，把心思放回當下你能掌握的事。同時誠實面對自己藏起來的感受，當你更坦然時，也許比較容易看見可以鬆動的地方。

en.name: Perthro
en.title: Cup of Fate
en.meaning: Hidden opportunity, the mystery of fate, and possibilities not yet revealed.
en.element: Water (fate, chance, and deeply held secrets)

upright.text: Perthro is like a cup holding your fate, reminding you that some wonderful opportunity is quietly brewing beneath the surface. It might be an unexpected turn, or a truth hidden just below the surface about to come to light. This is a good time to stay curious and open, rather than planning everything down to the last detail. Trust the unknown a little more -- it may hold a turning point worth noticing.

reversed.text: You might feel like luck isn't on your side, or something you were hoping for hasn't come together yet. Don't lose heart -- some things need time to brew, and forcing them tends to backfire. Try releasing your grip on the outcome and put your attention back on what you can actually control right now. Being honest about the feelings you've been hiding may also help you see where things can loosen up.

name: 亞茲
meaning: 看不見的守護、敏銳的直覺與守護自己的本能。
element: 風（連結天地的保護與直覺）

upright.text: 亞茲像麋鹿高舉的角，是一份溫柔而堅定的守護。它告訴你：你並不孤單，有股看不見的力量在支持著你。此刻請特別相信你的直覺--那種說不上來卻很清楚的感覺，往往是內在最忠實的提醒。為自己設立健康的界線，照顧好身心，你有能力守護好自己與所愛的人。

reversed.text: 你可能在忙碌中忽略了內心的提醒，或一直在硬撐、把自己放得太後面。這是個溫柔的警鐘：慢下來，傾聽身體與直覺發出的訊號。該休息就休息，該拒絕就拒絕，照顧自己不是自私。回到讓你感到安全與安心的人事物身邊，重新替自己補滿能量。

en.name: Algiz
en.title: Horn of Protection
en.meaning: Unseen protection, sharp intuition, and the instinct to guard yourself.
en.element: Air (protection and intuition linking heaven and earth)

upright.text: Algiz is like an elk's raised antlers -- a gentle but firm protection. It tells you: you're not alone, an unseen force is supporting you. Right now, trust your intuition especially -- that clear-but-hard-to-explain feeling is often your most reliable inner signal. Set healthy boundaries for yourself and take care of your body and mind; you're capable of protecting yourself and the people you love.

reversed.text: You might have been so busy that you ignored your own inner signals, or kept pushing yourself while putting your own needs last. This is a gentle wake-up call: slow down and listen to what your body and intuition are telling you. Rest when you need rest, decline when you need to decline -- caring for yourself isn't selfish. Return to the people and places that make you feel safe, and refill your own reserves.

name: 索維洛
meaning: 光明、活力與穿越陰霾後的成功與清明。
element: 火（太陽的光與生命的活力）

upright.text: 索維洛是高掛天際的太陽，帶來溫暖、活力與希望。再長的陰天也會放晴--這個符文告訴你，光明正照進你的生活，事情會逐漸明朗，你的努力也可能開始被看見。讓自己沐浴在這份能量裡，帶著自信與熱情往前走。你內在的光，足以照亮前方的路，也能溫暖身邊的人。

reversed.text: 索維洛正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：陽光雖好，曬過頭也會疲倦。你是不是一直拚命發光、不允許自己慢下來，或在順利時忽略了內心的某些角落？真正的明亮，是懂得在發光與休息之間取得平衡。給自己留點陰涼處歇息，也溫柔看見那些被光芒蓋過的感受。

en.name: Sowilo
en.title: Radiance of the Sun
en.meaning: Light, vitality, and the success and clarity that come after clouds pass.
en.element: Fire (the sun's light and life's vitality)

upright.text: Sowilo is the sun riding high overhead, bringing warmth, vitality, and hope. Even the longest overcast sky eventually clears -- this rune tells you that light is shining into your life, things are becoming clearer, and your effort may finally start being noticed. Let yourself soak in this energy and move forward with confidence and passion. Your inner light is enough to light the road ahead, and to warm the people around you.

reversed.text: Sowilo looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: as good as sunshine is, too much of it wears you out. Have you been pushing to shine nonstop, never letting yourself slow down, or overlooking certain feelings while things are going well? True brightness knows how to balance shining with resting. Leave yourself some shade to rest in, and gently notice the feelings the light has been outshining.

name: 提瓦茲
meaning: 正直的勇氣、為信念挺身而出的決心與公平。
element: 風（戰神提爾的正義與方向）

upright.text: 提瓦茲是戰神之矛，指向北極星般堅定的方向。它喚起你內在的勇氣，提醒你：為自己相信的事挺身而出，是一件值得驕傲的事。此刻適合堅守原則、做出正直的選擇，即使需要承擔一些代價。帶著光明磊落的心往前走，公道與努力值得被看見，也值得你持續爭取，你會贏得屬於自己的尊重。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺信心不足、不太敢為自己發聲，或覺得付出的努力沒有得到公平的對待。這是個提醒：先別急著責怪自己。重新衡量一下，哪些是值得堅持的戰役，哪些其實可以放下。勇氣不只是衝鋒，懂得在對的時候退一步、善待自己，同樣是一種成熟的力量。

en.name: Tiwaz
en.title: Spear of the War God
en.meaning: Honest courage, the resolve to stand up for what you believe, and fairness.
en.element: Air (the war god Tyr's justice and direction)

upright.text: Tiwaz is the spear of the war god, pointing as steadily as the North Star. It stirs your inner courage and reminds you: standing up for what you believe in is something to be proud of. This is a good time to hold your principles and make an honest choice, even if it costs you something. Walk forward with a clear conscience -- fairness and effort deserve to be seen, and are worth continuing to fight for. You'll earn the respect that's yours.

reversed.text: You might feel a lack of confidence, unsure about speaking up for yourself, or like your efforts haven't been treated fairly. Don't rush to blame yourself. Reassess which battles are worth holding your ground on, and which ones you can actually let go of. Courage isn't only about charging ahead -- knowing when to step back and treat yourself kindly is just as mature a strength.

name: 貝卡諾
meaning: 新生命的萌芽、溫柔的滋養與守護成長的母性能量。
element: 土（樺樹女神的孕育與守護）

upright.text: 貝卡諾是早春最先發芽的樺樹，象徵新生命、新計畫的開始。它帶著溫柔的母性能量，提醒你：好的開始需要被細心呵護與耐心陪伴。無論是一個夢想、一段關係，還是內在正在萌芽的自己，都值得你用愛去澆灌。慢慢來，給它時間成長，美好會在你的照顧下逐漸茁壯。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺某件事成長停滯，或家庭、親密關係裡有些需要關心的地方。這是個溫柔的提醒：回到根本，問問自己與身邊的人，是不是有什麼被忽略、需要重新被滋養。成長有快有慢，別太苛求。多一點耐心與陪伴，給彼此一些空間，停滯的能量會重新流動起來。

en.name: Berkano
en.title: Birch of New Life
en.meaning: The sprouting of new life, gentle nourishment, and the protective, maternal energy that tends growth.
en.element: Earth (the birch goddess's nurturing and protection)

upright.text: Berkano is the birch, first to bud in early spring, symbolizing new life and the start of a new plan. It carries a gentle, maternal energy, reminding you that a good beginning needs careful tending and patience. Whether it's a dream, a relationship, or a version of yourself that's just sprouting, it's worth watering with love. Take it slow, give it time to grow, and it will flourish under your care.

reversed.text: You might feel something has stalled in its growth, or that your family or a close relationship needs some attention. This is a gentle reminder: go back to basics and ask yourself and the people around you whether something has been overlooked and needs nourishing again. Growth has its fast and slow seasons -- don't be too hard on it. A little more patience and presence, and the stalled energy will start moving again.

name: 艾瓦茲
meaning: 信任的夥伴關係、同心協力與和諧的前進。
element: 土（人與馬同行的默契與旅程）

upright.text: 艾瓦茲是人與駿馬之間的默契，象徵一段值得信任的夥伴關係。也許是一位並肩同行的好友、一次順利的合作，或感情裡更深的信任。這個符文提醒你：好的關係建立在彼此信任與配合之上，像騎士與馬要同心才能跑得遠。珍惜身邊願意與你同行的人，攜手一起，路會走得更穩更遠。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺某段關係或合作有點失去默契，或一時得獨自面對許多事。別灰心，這是調整步調的機會。試著坦誠地溝通，把彼此的期待說清楚，信任往往能在誠實的對話中慢慢修復。就算暫時要靠自己，也別忘了：你有能力穩穩走好這段路，也可以為未來更合適的夥伴關係保留空間。

en.name: Ehwaz
en.title: Horse's Journey
en.meaning: A trusted partnership, working in sync, and moving forward in harmony.
en.element: Earth (the bond between rider and horse on the road)

upright.text: Ehwaz is the bond between rider and horse, symbolizing a partnership worth trusting. It might be a friend walking beside you, a collaboration going smoothly, or a deeper trust forming in a relationship. This rune reminds you: good relationships are built on mutual trust and coordination, like a rider and horse who have to move as one to go far. Cherish the people willing to walk this road with you -- together, the path is steadier and longer.

reversed.text: A relationship or collaboration might feel a bit out of sync, or you may find yourself having to handle things alone for a while. Don't be discouraged -- this is a chance to reset the pace. Try communicating honestly and naming your expectations clearly; trust often mends through honest conversation. Even if you have to rely on yourself for now, remember you're capable of walking this stretch steadily, and you can leave room for a better partnership ahead.

name: 瑪納茲
meaning: 身為人的自我探索、與他人的連結與群體中的歸屬。
element: 風（人性、心智與彼此映照的關係）

upright.text: 瑪納茲關乎「身為一個人」這件事--你是誰、你如何與他人相處。它提醒你：你不是一座孤島，身邊的人就像鏡子，映照出你的不同面向。此刻很適合好好認識自己，也用心經營與他人的關係。在群體裡找到自己的位置，懂得適時尋求支持，也願意伸出手，你會感受到深深的連結與歸屬。

reversed.text: 瑪納茲正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：你是不是最近有點把自己關起來，覺得沒人懂、或不好意思開口求助？孤單的時候，主動跨出一步格外重要。試著聯絡一位信任的人、加入一個讓你自在的群體。先溫柔地接納此刻的自己，再慢慢與世界重新連上線，你並不孤單。

en.name: Mannaz
en.title: Heart of Humanity
en.meaning: Self-exploration as a human being, connection with others, and belonging within a community.
en.element: Air (humanity, the mind, and the way we mirror each other)

upright.text: Mannaz is about what it means to be a person -- who you are, and how you relate to others. It reminds you: you're not an island, and the people around you act like mirrors, reflecting different sides of yourself. Now is a good time to get to know yourself better, and to invest in your relationships with others. Find your place in the group, ask for support when you need it, and be willing to offer a hand too -- you'll feel deep connection and belonging.

reversed.text: Mannaz looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: have you been shutting yourself away lately, feeling like nobody understands, or too embarrassed to ask for help? When you're feeling lonely, taking that first step matters even more. Try reaching out to someone you trust, or joining a group where you feel comfortable. Gently accept where you're at right now, then slowly reconnect with the world -- you're not alone.

name: 拉古茲
meaning: 情感的流動、直覺的指引與順勢而為的智慧。
element: 水（情感、潛意識與直覺的深流）

upright.text: 拉古茲是流動的水，象徵情感、直覺與潛意識的深處。它邀請你別硬碰硬，而是學習順著生命之流而行。此刻請多信任你的感覺--那些細微的情緒與直覺，正在為你指路。讓情感自然地流動，不壓抑也不氾濫，像水一樣柔軟而有力量，你會找到最自在、最適合自己的方向。

reversed.text: 你可能感覺被情緒的浪頭淹沒，或在感受裡有點迷失了方向。這是個溫柔的提醒：先讓自己上岸喘口氣。情緒來了沒關係，但你不需要被它帶著走。找回呼吸、做點讓自己安定的小事，等水面平靜下來，原本看不清的，自然會慢慢沉澱出答案。

en.name: Laguz
en.title: Way of the Water
en.meaning: The flow of feeling, the guidance of intuition, and the wisdom of moving with the current.
en.element: Water (feeling, the subconscious, and the deep current of intuition)

upright.text: Laguz is flowing water, symbolizing feeling, intuition, and the depths of the subconscious. It invites you not to fight the current, but to learn to move with the flow of life. Trust your feelings right now -- those subtle emotions and hunches are pointing the way. Let your feelings flow naturally, without suppressing or overflowing, soft yet powerful like water, and you'll find the direction that fits you best.

reversed.text: You might feel swept up by a wave of emotion, or a little lost in your own feelings. This is a gentle reminder: let yourself come up for air first. It's fine for emotion to arrive, but you don't have to be carried away by it. Find your breath, do something small that grounds you, and once the water settles, the answer that was unclear will slowly surface on its own.

name: 英瓦茲
meaning: 內在的醞釀與蓄積，以及階段圓滿後的釋放。
element: 土（豐饒之神的種子與孕育的能量）

upright.text: 英瓦茲是一顆藏在土裡、靜靜醞釀的種子，象徵某個階段正走向圓滿，而新的能量也在內在悄悄累積。它提醒你：有些成長是看不見的，正在地底默默扎根。給自己一段沉潛、準備的時間，把過去的經驗好好消化整合。當時機成熟，這份累積的能量會化為破土而出的力量。

reversed.text: 英瓦茲正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：你是不是準備了很久，卻遲遲不敢踏出那一步、不敢讓成果發生？種子若一直藏著不發芽，再多的醞釀也開不了花。給自己一點勇氣，相信你已經準備得夠了。溫柔地推自己一把，讓累積已久的能量，真正在世界裡綻放出來。

en.name: Ingwaz
en.title: Seed of Fertility
en.meaning: Inward gestation and accumulation, and the release that comes once a stage is complete.
en.element: Earth (the fertility god's seed and gestating energy)

upright.text: Ingwaz is a seed quietly brewing underground, symbolizing a stage moving toward completion while new energy gathers inside you. It reminds you: some growth is invisible, quietly putting down roots beneath the surface. Give yourself a stretch of quiet time to integrate and process what you've learned. When the timing is right, this accumulated energy will turn into the force that breaks through the soil.

reversed.text: Ingwaz looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: have you been preparing for a long time, but still can't bring yourself to take that step and let the results happen? A seed that stays buried and never sprouts won't bloom no matter how long it brews. Give yourself a little courage, and trust that you've prepared enough. Give yourself a gentle push, and let the energy you've built finally bloom out into the world.

name: 達加茲
meaning: 突破與覺醒，以及黑暗轉向光明的關鍵時刻。
element: 火（晝夜交界的曙光與覺醒）

upright.text: 達加茲是破曉的第一道曙光，象徵黑暗與光明交替、新的一天正要展開。它帶來突破與覺醒的能量，提醒你：那些困住你許久的事，正迎來轉機。也許是一個豁然開朗的領悟，或一個嶄新的開始。帶著希望迎接這道光，新的階段也許正在靠近；把注意力放在眼前可行的一步。

reversed.text: 達加茲正逆位同形，但它也邀請你看見另一面：你是不是正處在還看不清方向的過渡時刻，或站在轉變的門檻前，遲遲不敢跨出去？別灰心，這樣的過渡常讓人不安，但也許已經有一點光，正在慢慢靠近。再給自己一點堅持，鼓起勇氣往前一步。當你願意跨過那道界線，嶄新的風景就會展開。

en.name: Dagaz
en.title: Light of Dawn
en.meaning: Breakthrough and awakening, and the pivotal moment where darkness turns to light.
en.element: Fire (the dawn light at the border of night and day, and awakening)

upright.text: Dagaz is the first light of dawn, symbolizing the shift from darkness to light, a new day beginning. It carries breakthrough and awakening energy, reminding you: something that's held you back for a long time is reaching a turning point. It might be a sudden realization, or a brand-new start. Welcome this light with hope -- a new chapter may be close by; put your attention on the one step in front of you that's actually doable.

reversed.text: Dagaz looks the same upright or reversed, and it also invites you to notice: are you in a transitional moment where the direction still isn't clear, standing at a threshold of change but not quite daring to cross it? Don't lose heart -- transitions like this are often unsettling, but there may already be a little light quietly approaching. Give it a bit more persistence, and gather the courage to take one step forward. Once you're willing to cross that line, a whole new view opens up.

name: 奧提拉
meaning: 家族的傳承、心靈的根基與真正屬於自己的歸屬。
element: 土（祖先、家園與血脈的根基）

upright.text: 奧提拉是世代相傳的家園，象徵你的根、你的傳承，以及真正屬於你的歸屬感。它提醒你：別忘了自己從何而來，那些來自家族、文化或過往經驗的養分，正是你最穩固的基石。此刻很適合回顧自己重視的價值，鞏固生活與心靈的根基。當你與自己的根深深相連，無論走到哪裡，都更有機會感到踏實安定。

reversed.text: 你可能正面對一些與家族、歸屬有關的課題，或感覺找不到真正屬於自己的位置。這是個溫柔的邀請：試著與過往和解，分清楚哪些傳承值得珍惜，哪些包袱可以輕輕放下。家不只是血緣，也可以是你親手打造、讓自己安心的地方。慢慢來，你有能力為自己重新定義「歸屬」。

en.name: Othala
en.title: Root of the Homeland
en.meaning: Ancestral inheritance, a spiritual foundation, and a sense of belonging that's truly your own.
en.element: Earth (ancestors, homeland, and the roots of lineage)

upright.text: Othala is the homeland passed down through generations, symbolizing your roots, your inheritance, and a sense of belonging that's genuinely yours. It reminds you not to forget where you come from -- the nourishment from family, culture, and past experience is your most solid foundation. This is a good time to revisit the values you hold dear and strengthen the roots of your life and spirit. When you're deeply connected to your roots, you're more likely to feel grounded wherever you go.

reversed.text: You might be facing something related to family or belonging, or feel like you haven't found a place that's truly your own. This is a gentle invitation: try making peace with the past, sorting out which parts of your inheritance are worth cherishing and which weight can be gently set down. Home isn't only about blood ties -- it can also be a place you build with your own hands, where you feel safe. Take your time; you're capable of redefining 'belonging' for yourself.
